adoration.text: Adoration Room: Weekday 7 AM–10 PM; Weekend 7 AM–8 PM; Public Holiday 9 AM–5 PM. Closed on Mondays 9 AM–2 PM for cleaning; on 1st Mondays 9 AM–4 PM.

confession.text: Confession at L2 Confessionals 30 minutes before all weekend Masses when a priest is available.

devotions.text: Rosary is after weekday morning Mass and 40 minutes before weekday evening and weekend Masses.

office_hours.text: Weekday 9 AM–8 PM (lunch break 12 PM–1 PM); Saturday 9 AM–6 PM (lunch break 12 PM–1 PM); Sunday 9 AM–6 PM (lunch break 1 PM–2 PM).
